7658651.baseName: Habitat Woven Seagrass Christmas Tree Skirt
7658651.variantName: Habitat Woven Seagrass Christmas Tree Skirt
7658651.sourceDescription: Give your Christmas tree a modern, minimalist base with this woven seagrass tree skirt from Habitat. The natural texture brings warmth and style to your festive decor whilst cleverly hiding the tree base and stand. Scalloped edges add gentle curves that soften the look, making it feel festive without any fuss or flash. The seagrass material sits beautifully around the base of your tree, creating a calm, contemporary foundation that lets your decorations shine. It's designed for indoor use and brings that understated elegance to your seasonal setup. The natural finish works with any colour scheme, whether you're going bold and bright or keeping things minimal and muted. . Top diameter - 47cm . . Size H23.5, W47cm.; Diameter 68cm.; Weight 1.55kg.; Made from seagrass.; Suitable for indoor use.; Manufacturer's 1 year guarantee.

nqv9erft.variantName: Christmas Tree World 180cm Decorated Mixed Pine With Red Baubles Garland
nqv9erft.sourceDescription: This delightful Christmas garland is one of our favourite traditional Xmas accessories! Packed to the brim with frosted pinecones, artificial red berries, matte and shiny red Christmas baubles, and pretty pine foliage, it couldn’t be easier to fall in love with this 180cm decorated garland from Christmas Tree World! Please note: Decorated Mixed Pine wreath is not included. At 180cm, this festive garland is the perfect size for draping over mantelpieces, along staircases, and bordering doorways. A sight to behold all in itself, this garland really doesn’t need anything else to make it magical (although a few extra warm white Christmas LEDs do offer an extra dose of fairy dust!) Accessories shown in the images are not included with the item. The product is sold without any accessories. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

j4me1q2d.baseName: Christmas Village Premium Christmas Tree Stand with 1L Water Reservoir - Green
j4me1q2d.variantName: Christmas Village Premium Christmas Tree Stand with 1L Water Reservoir - Green
j4me1q2d.sourceDescription: The Christmas Village Premium Christmas Tree Stand provides a secure and practical base for real Christmas trees throughout the festive season. Designed to support trees up to 7ft tall and weighing up to 70kg, it features four adjustable screws to accommodate trunk diameters between 4cm and 11cm. The integrated 1L water reservoir helps keep your tree hydrated and reduces needle drop. Constructed from durable ABS plastic and steel, this lightweight 1.15kg stand is easy to position and store for future Christmas celebrations. Product dimensions: H15 × W56 × D56cm. Ensure the christmas tree stand is placed on a flat, stable surface before use. Do not exceed the maximum supported tree height of 7ft or weight capacity of 70kg. Secure the tree trunk firmly using all four adjustable screws. Keep the water reservoir topped up as required and avoid overfilling. Keep away from open flames and direct heat sources. Check stability regularly. HSI Global Ltd - 54 Cook Street, Glasgow, G5 8JN
